capabilities: Replace text on the current line as you type using regex patterns
Configure source and target regex pairs per pattern
Toggle requiring whitespace before a match
Toggle requiring a space after the match before replacing
extras: Only fires while typing and only on the current line; replacements are performed via JavaScript's String.replace.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically expand typed patterns like issue keys into Markdown links while writing.
summary: Live regex replacer that applies configurable source/target patterns to the current line as you type, e.g. expanding a Jira key into a link.
